param: C Constant recruitment into susceptible population (San Juan de Pasto); total recruits per year.
h Proportion of recruits that are men (used to split recruitment into male vs women).
c Proportion of men that are heterosexual (used to split male recruitment into heterosexual men vs homosexual men).
p Proportion of initially treated individuals among those leaving untreated infected class (branching to treatment vs AIDS).
λ Natural mortality rate (estimated from life expectancy 77.3 years).
d AIDS-induced mortality rate (average survival with AIDS ~3 years).
δ AIDS development rate in treated individuals due to ART resistance/treatment failure (T → A).
α Departure rate from all untreated infected compartments (I_h, I_w, I_m); governs leaving I to either treatment or AIDS.
b_h Probability of contagion per homosexual contact (exclusive homosexual contact).
c_h Rate/number of sexual partners in exclusive homosexual contact.
b_s Probability of contagion per exclusive heterosexual contact.
c_s Rate/number of sexual partners in exclusive heterosexual contact.
b_hw Probability of contagion per bisexual contact from homosexual men to women (h→w).
c_hw Rate/number of sexual partners for bisexual contact between homosexual men and women.
b_hm Probability of contagion per bisexual contact from homosexual men to heterosexual men (h→m).
c_hm Rate/number of sexual partners for bisexual contact between homosexual men and heterosexual men.
β_h Effective transmission coefficient for exclusive homosexual contact (partners rate × transmission probability).
β_s Effective transmission coefficient for exclusive heterosexual contact (partners rate × transmission probability).
R0_hom Basic reproduction number component for homosexual transmission (as reported: Rhom0 = ch*bh/(a+l)).
R0_het Basic reproduction number component for heterosexual transmission (as reported: Rhet0 = cs*bs/(a+l)).
C_h Recruitment into susceptible homosexual men.
C_w Recruitment into susceptible women.
C_m Recruitment into susceptible heterosexual men.
